facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use is + -ing para agora e am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: He’s digging a hole. I’m going to sit on the sand. Too antes do adjetivo quer dizer demais.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + verbo com -ing: He is pulling the leash. He’s digging a hole. As contrações são normais: he’s, I’m, we’re.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para falar de planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo base: I’m going to sit on the sand. We’re going to meet you at five. Depois de going to, o verbo não muda.

pages.title: A sunny street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday morning on a street in Miami. Palm trees move in the warm wind. Noah walks fast with a small brown dog. The dog’s tail goes left and right. His neighbor Jonas waves from his gate. Jonas asks about the walk.
“Hi, Noah! Where are you going with Rex?” says Jonas. “We’re going to the beach. He loves the water.” says Noah. “Is he walking well today?” says Jonas.
